network.notes: Copy into config/agent_config.json (or run: python recon_agents.py config set --base-url http://WINDOWS_HOST_IP:11434). Use the Windows host IP where Ollama listens — NOT the Kali/VM IP and NOT 127.0.0.1 from the VM. Prove with: curl http://HOST:11434/api/tags. Common host IPs: LAN (e.g. 192.168.1.4), VirtualBox host-only 192.168.56.1, some NAT 10.0.2.2, Docker Desktop host.docker.internal.
